main_text.l: [woodcut illustration: a crocodile pursuing a fleeing man, and a second man pursuing a fleeing crocodile; not transcribed as text]

l.i: Sic Vetus ille Draco, fauus mortalibus hoftis,
Te reprimente fugit, te fugiente premit.

page.notes: The initial N is a large woodcut letter joined to "Iliacus". The woodcut is an emblem picture and is described only in brackets above. The epigram is set in italic with a large roman initial; the first line's word "Iliacus" follows the initial. Some letters in the epigram ("Inftátes", "Vetus") are as printed in the scan and may be uncertain.
